facts.text: The Stockton Promise covers 100% of the gap between grants, scholarships, and tuition and fees for eligible students in their first or second year of study.

sources.title: The Stockton Promise - Office of Financial Aid | Stockton University
sources.quote: The Stockton Promise covers 100% of the gap between federal, state* and institutional financial aid funds (grants & scholarships) and the cost of tuition & fees for qualifying students who are in their first or second year of study
